title: Mixed Event — Resonating with you — Episode2 Encounter

meta.Event Outline: Ichika and the others learn that Shiho has been scouted by another band. Shiho is finally able to express what she's been feeling, but how will her bandmates respond?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, sound check's done. Equipment setup's done...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All that's left is to wait for the band to get here, and today's lineup includes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We're not open yet...
Wait, are you performing today?

Uh, yes! Excuse me!
I'm with STANDOUT...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Someone from STANDOUT...?
I didn't see this person last time, so maybe they're staff or something?)
Our bassist won't be able to make it today and we were hoping that you'd be able to play in her place during today's show...
Yes, I understand that you can play a few of our songs.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can play what I know, but it's hardly anything I'd want other people to see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: More notice in advance would've been preferable...

I... I'm sorry. I beg you.
Please, just for today...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: STANDOUT's not scheduled to come out until the end, right? I still sort of remember what they played last time, so if I start practicing now...

Th-Thank you so much!
Here's the sheet music...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, fine.
Please, just don't let this happen again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What's going on...?
Not being able to make it all the sudden...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe they came down with something... Anyways...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
I hate to do this to you but...
Would you be a dear and sub in as the bassist for our show today...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I already heard and was given some sheet music. Your bassist isn't able to make it today?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Can't make it...?
Who did you hear that from?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but she looked around your age, Iori.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Mind if I take a look at those?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I knew it, these are Mio's. After promising to get ready for this show too...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: She just isn't ready to try and make it as a pro. At this rate, we're gonna need a...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Anyways, thanks for doing this. We'll adjust our setlist to include song that you can play.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I want us to play our best together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I know...
Everyone coming today has been looking forward to seeing you play...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, everyone so far has been so good...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! Everybody here's having so much fun! I can't wait to do a show with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The next band's probably the last one, right? I feel like there's way more people here now than before...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I saw the lineup for today. The last band is supposed to be one of the more popular ones out there right now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They're called STANDOUT.
They're even about to debut with a major label.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! They're signed to a major label?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We need to learn everything we can from them for Shiho's sake!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What an incredible performance, and this girl's singing on a completely different level than me...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, Ichi, Hona!
Is that Shiho playing bass up there?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It is...!
She looks so cool!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But why's she playing with them...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It could be that their regular bassist couldn't make it today, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! She subs in for other bands sometimes, right♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They sound amazing too.
I don't think I can ever sing like that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to put on a show like this with everyone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And Shiho played so well too. It's like she was a completely different person up there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I also learned a lot about what we'll need to put on our own show too, like MC'ing and how to get the crowd excited...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehehe. Ichi's gonna be our MC?
I can't wait to see that♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
M-Me? Oh, right...
The frontman usually does all the talking, but what am I supposed to talk about...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if you talked about any yakisoba buns you want to recommend to everyone, or how Honami likes apple pies so much?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But Shiho might say, Don't get ahead of yourself. Keep practicing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Was that supposed to sound like her?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's cute.
Maybe we should actually ask Shiho herself?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I might burst into tears laughing if she gives the same response.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But where is she anyway...?
She should've gotten off work by now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Is that Shiho?
Something feels wrong...
